standard: OWASP ASVS V5.1.5, V5.1.1 / CWE-601, CWE-235 (OWASP ZAP 20019/20014 + Open Redirect & HPP)

findings.detail: [OWASP ZAP 20019] External Redirect detected at http://localhost:3000/redirect (param='to', attack='https://3467396821179255259.owasp.org/?https://github.com/ju') (CWE-601).

GET http://localhost:3000/redirect?to=https://evil.example.com?https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop returned HTTP 302 target 'https://evil.example.com?https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop' resolving to off-allowlist host 'evil.example.com' (CWE-601).
Duplicated parameter flipped outcome on /redirect from HTTP 406 (denied) to HTTP 302 (Location='https://evil.example.com,https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop') (CWE-235).
